custom_logic_notes: The EA combines SilverTrend (a signal indicator based on range breakout with dynamic thresholds using High/Low of a lookback period) and ColorJFatl_Digit (a JMA-based FATL digital filter with trend coloring). Entry requires both indicators to agree on direction: SilverTrend must signal and ColorJFatl_Digit trend color must confirm. Opposite signal first closes existing position, then opens new one on next signal bar. The digit adjustment pattern (multiplying SL/TP/Trail by 10 for 5-digit brokers) is a legacy MQL4 pattern carried into this MQ5 port. The custom indicator libraries (JFatl_Digit, CJfatl_Digit .mqh files) contain the core algorithm logic that must be manually ported.
python_conversion_notes: 1. SilverTrend indicator algorithm must be manually reimplemented - it calculates dynamic support/resistance levels from High/Low over a lookback period with a band multiplier. 2. ColorJFatl_Digit requires porting the JFatl (Jurik Fast Adaptive Trend Line) digital filter which depends on CJfatl_Digit class and JFatl_Digit algorithm from .mqh includes. 3. The digit adjustment (SL/TP * 10 for 5-digit) is unnecessary in Python since you work with absolute price values directly. 4. Position gate logic: EA checks IsPosition before entry - must implement position tracking. 5. Signal reversal close: opposite signal closes existing position first, new entry on next bar. 6. New bar detection uses static datetime comparison - implement equivalent bar tracking. 7. Trailing stop logic uses standard point-based trailing with digit adjustment. 8. Money management: negative Lots input = fixed lots; positive = risk-based sizing using AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_MARGIN) and order margin calculation.
